intro: Today's tech landscape highlights the complex tension between market dominance and internal operational challenges. We also explore new conceptual frameworks aimed at simplifying AI permission management.

must_know.title: A tale of two Nvidias
must_know.summary: Recent reports highlight a divergence between Nvidia's strong financial earnings and growing criticism from tech executives regarding the company's leadership and operational direction.
must_know.why_it_matters: Nvidia is the cornerstone of the AI hardware ecosystem, making executive criticism particularly notable for investors and partners.

must_know.title: 0rwx – A simple model of AI usage, inspired by Unix permissions
must_know.summary: 0rwx proposes a framework for managing AI usage rights by applying Unix-style permission models to AI operations.
must_know.why_it_matters: Establishing granular control over AI actions is a critical step for secure and governed enterprise AI adoption.
